Class Tags

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.style.Tags
All Implemented Interfaces:
Patchable<Tags>
public final class Tags extends Object implements Patchable<Tags>
A collection of tag names associated with a Style.

Tags are preserved from markup parsing and can be used as CSS class names for TFX effects targeting. When styles are patched together, tags are automatically merged (unioned) due to the Patchable implementation.

Example usage: 

// Create a style with tags
Style style = Style.EMPTY.withExtension(Tags.class, Tags.of("bold", "highlight"));

// Retrieve tags from a style
Tags tags = style.extension(Tags.class, Tags.empty());
for (String tag : tags.values()) {
    element.addClass(tag);
}
